title: e1.12 — the frame-latency probe the acceptance report measures
comment: A tiny scripted session whose only job is to be measured: open, move, quit. The numbers come
out of `tools/mvp_acceptance.py`, which reads the timings `tools/tui_session.py` writes.
`g` is in here because it is the one key that has to wait — 250 ms for the second keystroke of `gg` — and the frame marks the wait while it does (`reco-wlt`).

steps.note: open the TUI: time to the first frame
the graph key: it waits 250 ms for `gg`, and the frame says so while it waits
